games.name: Spooky Together

games.name: Baldi Together
games.description: Co-op for Baldi's Basics Plus (Steam): up to four players share one school, with Baldi, the other characters, items, the shop and elevators in sync. Play over your network or online through Steam. Everyone needs the same version.

games.name: MiSide Together
games.description: Co-op for MiSide (Steam): two to four players play the story together, with Mita, the cutscenes and the dialogue in sync. Friends join through Steam, your network or an address. Everyone needs the same version.

games.name: CupHeads
games.description: Online co-op for Cuphead: both cups, the host's save, bosses, run-and-gun and plane levels and the world map, over Steam invites or LAN. Originally made by Germanized; this fork is maintained by Multiplayer Everything. Everyone needs the same version.

games.name: Rick and Morty Together
games.description: Co-op for Rick and Morty: Virtual Rick-ality (Steam, VR): two players share one game as Morty clones in the same garage, see each other's head and hands, and pass things from hand to hand, with the story and the lines in sync. Everyone needs the same version.

games.name: Dave the Diver Multiplayer
games.description: Two-player online co-op for Dave the Diver: dive the Blue Hole together, see each other, and share the fish, the story and the sushi bar. Join a friend through Steam or LAN. Originally made by S1ii; this fork is maintained by Multiplayer Everything. Unofficial community mod. Everyone needs the same version.
